about_the_game:
Contents

The following items will be sent to your crate:

- 10 Legends Rise card pack tickets

How to Claim Items

Select Other from Add. Menus. Then select View DLC to claim your items.

Notice

- The First Farer Box can only be claimed once across all platforms. This means that even if you purchase the bundle again on another platform, the contents will not be added to your inventory or sent to your crate again. Please be careful that you don't make duplicate purchases.

- The First Farer Box can only be claimed once per Steam account.

- All items excluding crystals will be sent to your crate.

- Items sent to your crate will not have an expiration date.
